description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the engineering team at a European AI communications company as a Founding Product Engineer. You will take end-to-end ownership of customer-focused product features, from discovery and prototyping through production, helping businesses automate phone-based interactions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own features from initial hypotheses through implementation, release, and iteration.

 - Develop and test product ideas through rapid experiments and lightweight prototypes.

 - Stay in regular contact with customers, partners, and sales colleagues to identify real needs.

 - Define and implement product tracking, then use relevant metrics to guide decisions.

 - Build across the stack and lead architecture and implementation choices.

 - Balance pragmatic validation with long-term scalability, taking ownership to move initiatives forward.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least three years of product engineering experience delivering features end to end.

 - Full-stack experience with Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and React.

 - Experience owning software from architecture and implementation through production release.

 - Hands-on experience in a startup environment and a strong customer-focused product mindset.

 - German proficiency at B2 level or above, and fluent English for team and product communication.

 - Comfort using metrics and experiments to inform product decisions.

 - Experience integrating large language models or building AI-powered features is an advantage.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is €80,000 to €120,000 annually, with equity. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote role based in Germany, with overlap during Central European Time working hours.
